context: A doctor explains body autoregulation to a teen
purpose: Teach: 麻痺/朝鮮半島/自律/均衡/過度/引っ張っ/木材/機内

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 桜さん、体の自律神経のバランス、過度なストレスで崩れます。
lines.en: Sakura, your autonomic nervous system gets thrown off balance by excessive stress.
lines.style: Clear, clinical but not cold. Gentle opening. Steady, informative pace. The tone of someone who explains without oversimplifying, speaking to you as someone capable of understanding.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 勉強を引っ張って続けると、頭が麻痺するみたいで…。
lines.en: When I keep pushing my studying harder and harder, it's like my mind just goes numb.
lines.style: Quiet admission. Voice gets smaller on the words describing the paralysis. Hesitant phrasing — testing whether this is even the right way to describe it. Vulnerable without performing vulnerability.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 休息と均衡が大事です。長距離の機内のような乾燥環境も影響します。
lines.en: Rest and balance are really important. Dry environments like long airplane cabins affect your system too.
lines.style: Warm, unhurried delivery. Light emphasis on 'really important' — not lecturing, just marking what matters. Soft, conversational pacing. The reassurance of being heard and taken seriously.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 木材の家、ってリラックスに効くって本当ですか?
lines.en: Is it really true that wood-built houses help with relaxation?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity with a slight lift at the end. Leaning forward slightly in tone. No cynicism, no performance — just a real question to someone she trusts.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 湿度調整に効いて、自律神経も整いやすいです。朝鮮半島の伝統建築でも、同じ知恵が活きているそうですよ。
lines.en: Wood naturally regulates humidity, which makes it easier for your autonomic system to settle. Traditional architecture in Korea uses the same principle, actually.
lines.style: Warm, slightly animated. A small note of genuine interest in the knowledge itself — she's sharing something she finds meaningful. Conversational but precise. The rhythm of someone who loves explaining when she sees genuine interest.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.en: I learned so much from this!
lines.style: Genuine brightness — not forced cheerfulness but real relief and appreciation. Open, warm ending. The natural exhale of someone feeling both heard and helped.
